source_status: Supplied English records; source-edition limitations remain. No new original-language, apparatus or independent specialist verification is claimed.
completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.
canon_policy: Old Testament cross-references exclusively within the Saints Holy Bible 70-book edition: 43 source books in their exact order and divisions; matching targets restricted to its 70 books.
chapter_status_scope: Each chapters entry is one original source section; completed_chapters aggregates all source sections carrying the same native chapter number.

original_book_metadata.source_status: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 remains the user-authorized provisional base. Focused checks of the publisher’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not a complete critical-text or apparatus verification. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.

verses.display_text: All the rulers sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah son of Shelemiah son of Cushi to Baruch son of Neriah, saying, Take in your hand the roll from which you are reading to the people, and come. Baruch took the roll and went down to them.

verses.text: They said to him, Read it again to us. Baruch read it.
verses.display_text: They said to him, Read it again to us. Baruch read it.

verses.text: When they heard all the words, they consulted one another and said, Let us certainly report all these words to the king.
verses.display_text: When they heard all the words, they consulted one another and said, Let us certainly report all these words to the king.

verses.text: They asked Baruch, Where did all these words you wrote come from?
verses.display_text: They asked Baruch, Where did all these words you wrote come from?

verses.text: Baruch said, Jeremiah reported all these words to me from his mouth, and I wrote them in a document.
verses.display_text: Baruch said, Jeremiah reported all these words to me from his mouth, and I wrote them in a document.

verses.text: They said to Baruch, Go and hide, you and Jeremiah. Let no one know where you are.
verses.display_text: They said to Baruch, Go and hide, you and Jeremiah. Let no one know where you are.

verses.text: They entered the court to see the king, leaving the roll for safekeeping in Elishama’s house, and reported all the words to the king.
verses.display_text: They entered the court to see the king, leaving the roll for safekeeping in Elishama’s house, and reported all the words to the king.

verses.text: The king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll. He took it from Elishama’s house, and Jehudi read it to the king and all the rulers standing around him.
verses.display_text: The king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll. He took it from Elishama’s house, and Jehudi read it to the king and all the rulers standing around him.

verses.text: The king was sitting in a winter house, with a fire brazier before him.
verses.display_text: The king was sitting in a winter house, with a fire brazier before him.

verses.text: When Jehudi read three or four columns, the king cut them off with the scribe’s knife and threw them into the fire on the brazier, until the whole roll was consumed in the brazier’s fire.
verses.display_text: When Jehudi read three or four columns, the king cut them off with the scribe’s knife and threw them into the fire on the brazier, until the whole roll was consumed in the brazier’s fire.

verses.text: Neither the king nor his servants who heard all these words sought anything or tore their garments.
verses.display_text: Neither the king nor his servants who heard all these words sought anything or tore their garments.

verses.text: Elnathan, Gedaliah, and Gemariah advised the king not to burn the roll.
verses.display_text: Elnathan, Gedaliah, and Gemariah advised the king not to burn the roll.

verses.text: The king ordered Jerahmeel the king’s son and Seraiah son of Azriel to arrest Baruch and Jeremiah. But they were hidden.
verses.display_text: The king ordered Jerahmeel the king’s son and Seraiah son of Azriel to arrest Baruch and Jeremiah. But they were hidden.

verses.text: After the king burned the roll—all the words Baruch had written from Jeremiah’s mouth—the Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:
verses.display_text: After the king burned the roll—all the words Baruch had written from Jeremiah’s mouth—the Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:

verses.text: Take another roll again and write all the words that were on the roll which King Jehoiakim burned.
verses.display_text: Take another roll again and write all the words that were on the roll which King Jehoiakim burned.

verses.text: Say, Thus said the Lord: You burned this roll, saying, Why did you write in it that Babylon’s king will certainly enter and destroy this land, and people and animals will cease from it?
verses.display_text: Say, Thus said the Lord: You burned this roll, saying, Why did you write in it that Babylon’s king will certainly enter and destroy this land, and people and animals will cease from it?

verses.text: Therefore thus said the Lord concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one sitting on David’s throne. His carcass will be thrown out in the day’s heat and the night’s frost.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus said the Lord concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one sitting on David’s throne. His carcass will be thrown out in the day’s heat and the night’s frost.

verses.text: I will visit him, his family, and his servants, and bring upon them, Jerusalem’s inhabitants, and Judah’s land all the calamities I pronounced to them, but they did not listen.
verses.display_text: I will visit him, his family, and his servants, and bring upon them, Jerusalem’s inhabitants, and Judah’s land all the calamities I pronounced to them, but they did not listen.

verses.text: Baruch took another roll and wrote on it, from Jeremiah’s mouth, all the words of the document Jehoiakim burned. Still more words like these were added to it.
verses.display_text: Baruch took another roll and wrote on it, from Jeremiah’s mouth, all the words of the document Jehoiakim burned. Still more words like these were added to it.

verses.text: Zedekiah son of Josiah reigned in place of Jehoiakim; Nebuchadnezzar had made him king over Judah.
verses.display_text: Zedekiah son of Josiah reigned in place of Jehoiakim; Nebuchadnezzar had made him king over Judah.

verses.text: Neither he nor his servants nor the people of the land obeyed the Lord’s words, which He spoke through Jeremiah.
verses.display_text: Neither he nor his servants nor the people of the land obeyed the Lord’s words, which He spoke through Jeremiah.

verses.text: King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest to Jeremiah, saying, Please pray for us to the Lord.
verses.display_text: King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest to Jeremiah, saying, Please pray for us to the Lord.

verses.text: Jeremiah came and passed through the midst of the city; they had not put him in prison.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah came and passed through the midst of the city; they had not put him in prison.

verses.text: Pharaoh’s force came out of Egypt. The Chaldeans heard the report about them and withdrew from Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: Pharaoh’s force came out of Egypt. The Chaldeans heard the report about them and withdrew from Jerusalem.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: Tell Judah’s king, who sent to you to seek Me, Pharaoh’s force, which came out to help you, will return to Egypt’s land.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: Tell Judah’s king, who sent to you to seek Me, Pharaoh’s force, which came out to help you, will return to Egypt’s land.

verses.text: The Chaldeans themselves will return, fight this city, seize it, and burn it with fire.
verses.display_text: The Chaldeans themselves will return, fight this city, seize it, and burn it with fire.

verses.text: For thus said the Lord: Do not suppose within yourselves, The Chaldeans will flee and leave us. They certainly will not leave.
verses.display_text: For thus said the Lord: Do not suppose within yourselves, The Chaldeans will flee and leave us. They certainly will not leave.

verses.text: Even if you struck the whole Chaldean force fighting you and some were left pierced through, each in his place, these would rise and burn this city with fire.
verses.display_text: Even if you struck the whole Chaldean force fighting you and some were left pierced through, each in his place, these would rise and burn this city with fire.

verses.text: When the Chaldean force withdrew from Jerusalem because of Pharaoh’s force,
verses.display_text: When the Chaldean force withdrew from Jerusalem because of Pharaoh’s force,

verses.text: Jeremiah left Jerusalem to go to Benjamin’s land, to buy from there among the people.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah left Jerusalem to go to Benjamin’s land, to buy from there among the people.

verses.text: At Benjamin’s Gate there was a man with whom he lodged, Sarouiah son of Shelemiah son of Hananiah. He arrested Jeremiah, saying, You are fleeing to the Chaldeans!
verses.display_text: At Benjamin’s Gate there was a man with whom he lodged, Sarouiah son of Shelemiah son of Hananiah. He arrested Jeremiah, saying, You are fleeing to the Chaldeans!

verses.text: He said, A lie! I am not fleeing to the Chaldeans. But Sarouiah would not listen to him; he arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the rulers.
verses.display_text: He said, A lie! I am not fleeing to the Chaldeans. But Sarouiah would not listen to him; he arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the rulers.

verses.text: The rulers were embittered against Jeremiah. They struck him and sent him into the house of Jonathan the scribe, which they had made into a prison house.
verses.display_text: The rulers were embittered against Jeremiah. They struck him and sent him into the house of Jonathan the scribe, which they had made into a prison house.

verses.text: Jeremiah entered the pit-house and the chereth and stayed there many days.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah entered the pit-house and the chereth and stayed there many days.

verses.text: Zedekiah sent and summoned him. The king secretly asked him whether there was a word from the Lord. He said, There is. You will be handed over to Babylon’s king.
verses.display_text: Zedekiah sent and summoned him. The king secretly asked him whether there was a word from the Lord. He said, There is. You will be handed over to Babylon’s king.

verses.text: Jeremiah said to the king, How have I wronged you, your servants, or this people, that you are putting me in prison?
verses.display_text: Jeremiah said to the king, How have I wronged you, your servants, or this people, that you are putting me in prison?

verses.text: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, Babylon’s king certainly will not come against this land?
verses.display_text: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, Babylon’s king certainly will not come against this land?

verses.text: Now, lord king, let my appeal for mercy fall before you. Why send me back to Jonathan the scribe’s house—and will I not die there?
verses.display_text: Now, lord king, let my appeal for mercy fall before you. Why send me back to Jonathan the scribe’s house—and will I not die there?

verses.text: The king gave orders, and they put him into the prison house, giving him one loaf a day from outside where they bake, until the city’s loaves ran out. Jeremiah remained in the prison court.
verses.display_text: The king gave orders, and they put him into the prison house, giving him one loaf a day from outside where they bake, until the city’s loaves ran out. Jeremiah remained in the prison court.

verses.text: Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, and Jehucal son of Shelemiah heard the words Jeremiah was speaking to the people:
verses.display_text: Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, and Jehucal son of Shelemiah heard the words Jeremiah was speaking to the people:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: Whoever remains in this city will die by sword and famine. Whoever goes out to the Chaldeans will live; his life will be his gain, and he will live.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: Whoever remains in this city will die by sword and famine. Whoever goes out to the Chaldeans will live; his life will be his gain, and he will live.

verses.text: For thus said the Lord: This city will certainly be handed over to the force of Babylon’s king, and he will seize it.
verses.display_text: For thus said the Lord: This city will certainly be handed over to the force of Babylon’s king, and he will seize it.

verses.text: They said to the king, Let that man be killed! By speaking these words to them he weakens the hands of the fighters left in the city and of all the people. This man delivers oracles of evil to this people, not peace.
verses.display_text: They said to the king, Let that man be killed! By speaking these words to them he weakens the hands of the fighters left in the city and of all the people. This man delivers oracles of evil to this people, not peace.

verses.text: The king said, He is in your hands—for the king was unable to oppose them.
verses.display_text: The king said, He is in your hands—for the king was unable to oppose them.

verses.text: They threw him into the pit of Malchiah the king’s son in the prison court and lowered him into the pit. There was no water in it, only mire, and he was in the mire.
verses.display_text: They threw him into the pit of Malchiah the king’s son in the prison court and lowered him into the pit. There was no water in it, only mire, and he was in the mire.

verses.text: Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, who was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the pit. The king was at Benjamin’s Gate.
verses.display_text: Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, who was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the pit. The king was at Benjamin’s Gate.

verses.text: He went out to him, spoke to the king, and said:
verses.display_text: He went out to him, spoke to the king, and said:

verses.text: You have acted wickedly in what you did, killing this man through hunger, for there are no more loaves in the city.
verses.display_text: You have acted wickedly in what you did, killing this man through hunger, for there are no more loaves in the city.

verses.text: The king instructed Ebed-melech, Take thirty men from here under your command and bring him up from the pit so that he does not die.
verses.display_text: The king instructed Ebed-melech, Take thirty men from here under your command and bring him up from the pit so that he does not die.

verses.text: Ebed-melech took the men and entered the king’s underground house. He took old rags and old ropes from there and threw them down to Jeremiah in the pit.
verses.display_text: Ebed-melech took the men and entered the king’s underground house. He took old rags and old ropes from there and threw them down to Jeremiah in the pit.

verses.text: He said, Put these beneath the ropes. Jeremiah did so.
verses.display_text: He said, Put these beneath the ropes. Jeremiah did so.

verses.text: They pulled him with the ropes and brought him up from the pit. Jeremiah remained in the prison court.
verses.display_text: They pulled him with the ropes and brought him up from the pit. Jeremiah remained in the prison court.

verses.text: The king sent and summoned him to himself, to the aselisi house in the Lord’s house. The king said to him, I will ask you something. Please hide no word from me.
verses.display_text: The king sent and summoned him to himself, to the aselisi house in the Lord’s house. The king said to him, I will ask you something. Please hide no word from me.

verses.text: Jeremiah said to the king, If I tell you, will you not certainly put me to death? And if I advise you, you certainly will not listen to me.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah said to the king, If I tell you, will you not certainly put me to death? And if I advise you, you certainly will not listen to me.

verses.text: The king swore to him, As the Lord lives, who made this life for us, I will not kill you or hand you over to these men.
verses.display_text: The king swore to him, As the Lord lives, who made this life for us, I will not kill you or hand you over to these men.

verses.text: Jeremiah said to him, Thus said the Lord: If you go out to Babylon’s king’s commanders, your life will be spared and this city will certainly not be burned with fire. You and your household will live.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah said to him, Thus said the Lord: If you go out to Babylon’s king’s commanders, your life will be spared and this city will certainly not be burned with fire. You and your household will live.

verses.text: But if you do not go out, this city will be handed over to the Chaldeans and they will burn it with fire. You certainly will not be saved.
verses.display_text: But if you do not go out, this city will be handed over to the Chaldeans and they will burn it with fire. You certainly will not be saved.

verses.text: The king said to Jeremiah, I am concerned about the Judeans who have fled to the Chaldeans, lest they hand me over to them and mock me.
verses.display_text: The king said to Jeremiah, I am concerned about the Judeans who have fled to the Chaldeans, lest they hand me over to them and mock me.

verses.text: Jeremiah said, They certainly will not hand you over. Hear the Lord’s word which I speak to you, and it will be better for you; your life will be spared.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah said, They certainly will not hand you over. Hear the Lord’s word which I speak to you, and it will be better for you; your life will be spared.

verses.text: But if you are unwilling to go out, this is the word the Lord showed me:
verses.display_text: But if you are unwilling to go out, this is the word the Lord showed me:

verses.text: All the women left in Judah’s king’s house were being brought out to Babylon’s king’s rulers. They said, Your peaceful friends deceived you and will overpower you. They will bring your feet to rest in slippery places; they turned away from you.
verses.display_text: All the women left in Judah’s king’s house were being brought out to Babylon’s king’s rulers. They said, Your peaceful friends deceived you and will overpower you. They will bring your feet to rest in slippery places; they turned away from you.

verses.text: They will bring your wives and children out to the Chaldeans. You certainly will not be saved, for Babylon’s king will seize you, and this city will be burned.
verses.display_text: They will bring your wives and children out to the Chaldeans. You certainly will not be saved, for Babylon’s king will seize you, and this city will be burned.

verses.text: The king said to him, Let no one learn anything of these words, and you certainly will not die.
verses.display_text: The king said to him, Let no one learn anything of these words, and you certainly will not die.

verses.text: If the rulers hear that I spoke to you, come to you, and say, Tell us what the king said to you. Hide nothing from us and we certainly will not kill you. What did the king say to you?
verses.display_text: If the rulers hear that I spoke to you, come to you, and say, Tell us what the king said to you. Hide nothing from us and we certainly will not kill you. What did the king say to you?

verses.text: tell them, I am casting my appeal for mercy before the king’s eyes, not to send me back to Jonathan’s house to die there.
verses.display_text: tell them, I am casting my appeal for mercy before the king’s eyes, not to send me back to Jonathan’s house to die there.

verses.text: All the rulers came to Jeremiah and questioned him. He reported everything the king had instructed him, and they fell silent, because the Lord’s word had not been heard.
verses.display_text: All the rulers came to Jeremiah and questioned him. He reported everything the king had instructed him, and they fell silent, because the Lord’s word had not been heard.

verses.text: Jeremiah remained in the prison court until the time Jerusalem was captured.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah remained in the prison court until the time Jerusalem was captured.

verses.text: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his whole force arrived against Jerusalem and besieged it.
verses.display_text: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his whole force arrived against Jerusalem and besieged it.

verses.text: In Zedekiah’s eleventh year, on the ninth day of the fourth month, the city was breached.
verses.display_text: In Zedekiah’s eleventh year, on the ninth day of the fourth month, the city was breached.

verses.text: All Babylon’s king’s commanders entered and sat at the Middle Gate: Nargalasar, Samagoth, Nabousachar, Nabousaris, Nagargasnaser Rabamag, and the remaining commanders of Babylon’s king.
verses.display_text: All Babylon’s king’s commanders entered and sat at the Middle Gate: Nargalasar, Samagoth, Nabousachar, Nabousaris, Nagargasnaser Rabamag, and the remaining commanders of Babylon’s king.

verses.text: They sent and took Jeremiah from the prison court and handed him over to Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan. They brought him out, and he lived among the people.
verses.display_text: They sent and took Jeremiah from the prison court and handed him over to Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan. They brought him out, and he lived among the people.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah in the prison court:
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah in the prison court:

verses.text: Go and tell Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: I am bringing My words upon this city for calamity, not good.
verses.display_text: Go and tell Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: I am bringing My words upon this city for calamity, not good.

verses.text: I will save you that day and certainly will not hand you over to the men you fear.
verses.display_text: I will save you that day and certainly will not hand you over to the men you fear.

verses.text: I will certainly save you. You certainly will not fall by the sword; your life will be your gain because you trusted in Me, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: I will certainly save you. You certainly will not fall by the sword; your life will be your gain because you trusted in Me, says the Lord.

verses.text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah afterward, after Nebuzaradan, the chief guard from Daman, sent him away, when he took him in handcuffs among Judah’s exiles who were being led to Babylon.
verses.display_text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah afterward, after Nebuzaradan, the chief guard from Daman, sent him away, when he took him in handcuffs among Judah’s exiles who were being led to Babylon.

verses.text: The chief guard took him and said to him, The Lord your God spoke these calamities against this place.
verses.display_text: The chief guard took him and said to him, The Lord your God spoke these calamities against this place.

verses.text: And the Lord acted, because you sinned against Him and did not obey His voice.
verses.display_text: And the Lord acted, because you sinned against Him and did not obey His voice.

verses.text: Behold, I have released you from the handcuffs on your hands. If it seems good to you to come with me to Babylon, come, and I will look after you.
verses.display_text: Behold, I have released you from the handcuffs on your hands. If it seems good to you to come with me to Babylon, come, and I will look after you.

verses.text: But if not, go off and return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan, whom Babylon’s king appointed in Judah’s land, and live with him among the people in Judah’s land. Go wherever it seems good in your eyes to go. The chief guard gave him gifts and sent him away.
verses.display_text: But if not, go off and return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan, whom Babylon’s king appointed in Judah’s land, and live with him among the people in Judah’s land. Go wherever it seems good in your eyes to go. The chief guard gave him gifts and sent him away.

verses.text: He came to Gedaliah at Mizpah and lived among the people left in the land.
verses.display_text: He came to Gedaliah at Mizpah and lived among the people left in the land.

verses.text: All the commanders of the force in the countryside, they and their men, heard that Babylon’s king had appointed Gedaliah in the land and had entrusted to him men and their wives whom he had not deported to Babylon.
verses.display_text: All the commanders of the force in the countryside, they and their men, heard that Babylon’s king had appointed Gedaliah in the land and had entrusted to him men and their wives whom he had not deported to Babylon.

verses.text: Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ophe the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maacathite came to Gedaliah at Mizpah, they and their men.
verses.display_text: Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ophe the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maacathite came to Gedaliah at Mizpah, they and their men.

verses.text: Gedaliah swore to them and their men, saying, Do not be afraid of the Chaldeans’ servants. Live in the land and work for Babylon’s king, and it will be better for you.
verses.display_text: Gedaliah swore to them and their men, saying, Do not be afraid of the Chaldeans’ servants. Live in the land and work for Babylon’s king, and it will be better for you.

verses.text: Behold, I am staying before you at Mizpah to stand before the Chaldeans who come against you. Gather wine and summer fruit, gather oil, put them in your containers, and live in the cities you have taken over.
verses.display_text: Behold, I am staying before you at Mizpah to stand before the Chaldeans who come against you. Gather wine and summer fruit, gather oil, put them in your containers, and live in the cities you have taken over.

verses.text: All the Judeans in Moab’s land, among Ammon’s people, in Idumea, and in all the land heard that Babylon’s king had left a remnant for Judah and appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam over them.
verses.display_text: All the Judeans in Moab’s land, among Ammon’s people, in Idumea, and in all the land heard that Babylon’s king had left a remnant for Judah and appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam over them.

verses.text: They came to Gedaliah in Judah’s land at Mizpah and gathered a very great amount of wine and summer fruit, and oil.
verses.display_text: They came to Gedaliah in Judah’s land at Mizpah and gathered a very great amount of wine and summer fruit, and oil.

verses.text: Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the force in the countryside came to Gedaliah at Mizpah.
verses.display_text: Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the force in the countryside came to Gedaliah at Mizpah.

verses.text: They said to him, Do you really know that Belisa king of Ammon’s people has sent Ishmael to you to take your life? But Gedaliah did not believe them.
verses.display_text: They said to him, Do you really know that Belisa king of Ammon’s people has sent Ishmael to you to take your life? But Gedaliah did not believe them.

verses.text: Johanan spoke secretly to Gedaliah at Mizpah: Let me go and strike down Ishmael, and let no one know, lest he take your life and all Judah gathered to you be scattered, and Judah’s survivors perish.
verses.display_text: Johanan spoke secretly to Gedaliah at Mizpah: Let me go and strike down Ishmael, and let no one know, lest he take your life and all Judah gathered to you be scattered, and Judah’s survivors perish.

verses.text: Gedaliah said to Johanan, Do not do this thing, for you are speaking falsehoods about Ishmael.
verses.display_text: Gedaliah said to Johanan, Do not do this thing, for you are speaking falsehoods about Ishmael.

verses.text: In the seventh month, Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Elasa, of the king’s family, came with ten men to Gedaliah at Mizpah. They ate bread together there.
verses.display_text: In the seventh month, Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Elasa, of the king’s family, came with ten men to Gedaliah at Mizpah. They ate bread together there.

verses.text: Ishmael and the ten men with him rose and struck Gedaliah, whom Babylon’s king had appointed over the land,

verses.text: and all the Judeans with him at Mizpah, and all the Chaldeans found there.
verses.display_text: and all the Judeans with him at Mizpah, and all the Chaldeans found there.

verses.text: On the second day after he struck Gedaliah, when no one knew,

verses.text: eighty men came from Shechem, Salem, and Samaria, with shaved beards and torn clothes, beating themselves, carrying grain offerings and frankincense to bring to the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: eighty men came from Shechem, Salem, and Samaria, with shaved beards and torn clothes, beating themselves, carrying grain offerings and frankincense to bring to the Lord’s house.

verses.text: Ishmael went out to meet them. They were walking and weeping, and he said to them, Come in to Gedaliah.
verses.display_text: Ishmael went out to meet them. They were walking and weeping, and he said to them, Come in to Gedaliah.

verses.text: When they entered the middle of the city, he slaughtered them into the cistern.
verses.display_text: When they entered the middle of the city, he slaughtered them into the cistern.

verses.text: Ten men found there said to Ishmael, Do not kill us, for we have stores in the countryside: wheat, barley, honey, and oil. He passed them by and did not kill them among their brothers.
verses.display_text: Ten men found there said to Ishmael, Do not kill us, for we have stores in the countryside: wheat, barley, honey, and oil. He passed them by and did not kill them among their brothers.

verses.text: The cistern into which Ishmael threw all those he had struck down is a large cistern that King Asa made because of Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael filled it with the slain.
verses.display_text: The cistern into which Ishmael threw all those he had struck down is a large cistern that King Asa made because of Baasha king of Israel. Ishmael filled it with the slain.

verses.text: Ishmael turned back all the people left at Mizpah and the king’s daughters whom the chief guard had entrusted to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, and he went away to the far side of Ammon’s people.
verses.display_text: Ishmael turned back all the people left at Mizpah and the king’s daughters whom the chief guard had entrusted to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, and he went away to the far side of Ammon’s people.

verses.text: Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the force with him heard of all the evils Ishmael had done.
verses.display_text: Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the force with him heard of all the evils Ishmael had done.

verses.text: They led their entire army and went away to fight him. They found him beside abundant water at Gibeon.
verses.display_text: They led their entire army and went away to fight him. They found him beside abundant water at Gibeon.

verses.text: When all the people with Ishmael saw Johanan and the commanders of the force with him,
verses.display_text: When all the people with Ishmael saw Johanan and the commanders of the force with him,

verses.text: they returned to Johanan.
verses.display_text: they returned to Johanan.

verses.text: Ishmael escaped with eight men and went away to Ammon’s people.
verses.display_text: Ishmael escaped with eight men and went away to Ammon’s people.

verses.text: Johanan and all the commanders of the force with him took all the people left whom he had brought back from Ishmael: men mighty in war, the women, the rest, and the eunuchs whom he brought back from Gibeon.
verses.display_text: Johanan and all the commanders of the force with him took all the people left whom he had brought back from Ishmael: men mighty in war, the women, the rest, and the eunuchs whom he brought back from Gibeon.

verses.text: They went away and stayed at Gaberoth-chamaam near Bethlehem, intending to go into Egypt,
verses.display_text: They went away and stayed at Gaberoth-chamaam near Bethlehem, intending to go into Egypt,

verses.text: away from the Chaldeans, for they feared them because Ishmael had struck Gedaliah, whom Babylon’s king had appointed in the land.
verses.display_text: away from the Chaldeans, for they feared them because Ishmael had struck Gedaliah, whom Babylon’s king had appointed in the land.

verses.text: All the commanders of the force, Johanan, Azariah son of Maaseiah, and all the people, from the least to the greatest, approached
verses.display_text: All the commanders of the force, Johanan, Azariah son of Maaseiah, and all the people, from the least to the greatest, approached

verses.text: Jeremiah the prophet and said to him, Please let our appeal for mercy come before you. Pray to the Lord your God for these survivors, for few of us remain out of many, as your eyes see.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah the prophet and said to him, Please let our appeal for mercy come before you. Pray to the Lord your God for these survivors, for few of us remain out of many, as your eyes see.

verses.text: Let the Lord your God tell us the way we should go and the matter we should carry out.
verses.display_text: Let the Lord your God tell us the way we should go and the matter we should carry out.

verses.text: Jeremiah said to them, I have heard. I will pray to the Lord our God as you have said. Whatever word the Lord answers, I will tell you; I certainly will not hide a word from you.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah said to them, I have heard. I will pray to the Lord our God as you have said. Whatever word the Lord answers, I will tell you; I certainly will not hide a word from you.

verses.text: They said to Jeremiah, May the Lord be a righteous and faithful witness among us if we do not act according to every word with which the Lord sends you to us.
verses.display_text: They said to Jeremiah, May the Lord be a righteous and faithful witness among us if we do not act according to every word with which the Lord sends you to us.

verses.text: Whether good or bad, we will obey the voice of the Lord our God, to whom we are sending you, so that it may be better for us, because we will obey the voice of the Lord our God.
verses.display_text: Whether good or bad, we will obey the voice of the Lord our God, to whom we are sending you, so that it may be better for us, because we will obey the voice of the Lord our God.

verses.text: After ten days, the Lord’s word came to Jeremiah.
verses.display_text: After ten days, the Lord’s word came to Jeremiah.

verses.text: He called Johanan, the commanders of the force, and all the people, from the least to the greatest.
verses.display_text: He called Johanan, the commanders of the force, and all the people, from the least to the greatest.

verses.text: He said to them, Thus said the Lord:
verses.display_text: He said to them, Thus said the Lord:

verses.text: If you remain in this land, I will build you up and certainly not tear you down; I will plant you and certainly not pluck you up. For I have rested from the calamities I brought upon you.
verses.display_text: If you remain in this land, I will build you up and certainly not tear you down; I will plant you and certainly not pluck you up. For I have rested from the calamities I brought upon you.

verses.text: Do not fear Babylon’s king, whom you fear. Do not fear, says the Lord, for I am with you to rescue you and save you from his hand.
verses.display_text: Do not fear Babylon’s king, whom you fear. Do not fear, says the Lord, for I am with you to rescue you and save you from his hand.

verses.text: I will grant you mercy, have mercy on you, and return you to your land.
verses.display_text: I will grant you mercy, have mercy on you, and return you to your land.

verses.text: But if you say, We certainly will not remain in this land, so as not to obey the Lord’s voice,
verses.display_text: But if you say, We certainly will not remain in this land, so as not to obey the Lord’s voice,

verses.text: because we will enter Egypt’s land, certainly not see war or hear the trumpet’s sound or hunger for bread, and there we will live—
verses.display_text: because we will enter Egypt’s land, certainly not see war or hear the trumpet’s sound or hunger for bread, and there we will live—

verses.text: therefore hear the Lord’s word. Thus said the Lord: If you set your faces toward Egypt and go in to live there,
verses.display_text: therefore hear the Lord’s word. Thus said the Lord: If you set your faces toward Egypt and go in to live there,

verses.text: the sword you fear will find you in Egypt’s land, and the famine you are concerned about will catch up with you from behind in Egypt, and there you will die.
verses.display_text: the sword you fear will find you in Egypt’s land, and the famine you are concerned about will catch up with you from behind in Egypt, and there you will die.

verses.text: All the people and all the foreigners who set their faces toward Egypt’s land to live there will perish by sword and famine. None of them will be saved from the calamities I am bringing upon them.
verses.display_text: All the people and all the foreigners who set their faces toward Egypt’s land to live there will perish by sword and famine. None of them will be saved from the calamities I am bringing upon them.

verses.text: For thus said the Lord: As My wrath dripped upon Jerusalem’s inhabitants, so My wrath will drip upon you when you enter Egypt. You will become an untrodden place, subject to others, a curse, and a reproach, and you certainly will never see this place again.
verses.display_text: For thus said the Lord: As My wrath dripped upon Jerusalem’s inhabitants, so My wrath will drip upon you when you enter Egypt. You will become an untrodden place, subject to others, a curse, and a reproach, and you certainly will never see this place again.

verses.text: These are the things the Lord spoke concerning you, Judah’s survivors: Do not enter Egypt. And now know for certain
verses.display_text: These are the things the Lord spoke concerning you, Judah’s survivors: Do not enter Egypt. And now know for certain

verses.text: that you acted wickedly in your souls when you sent me, saying, Pray for us to the Lord, and we will do everything the Lord tells you.
verses.display_text: that you acted wickedly in your souls when you sent me, saying, Pray for us to the Lord, and we will do everything the Lord tells you.

verses.text: And you did not obey the Lord’s voice, with which He sent me to you.
verses.display_text: And you did not obey the Lord’s voice, with which He sent me to you.

verses.text: And now you will perish by sword and famine in the place where you want to go and live.
verses.display_text: And now you will perish by sword and famine in the place where you want to go and live.

verses.text: When Jeremiah stopped speaking to the people all the Lord’s words, with which the Lord had sent him to them—all these words—
verses.display_text: When Jeremiah stopped speaking to the people all the Lord’s words, with which the Lord had sent him to them—all these words—

verses.text: Azariah son of Maaseiah, Johanan son of Kareah, and all the men who spoke said to Jeremiah, You are lying! The Lord did not send you to us to say, Do not enter Egypt to live there.
verses.display_text: Azariah son of Maaseiah, Johanan son of Kareah, and all the men who spoke said to Jeremiah, You are lying! The Lord did not send you to us to say, Do not enter Egypt to live there.

verses.text: Rather, Baruch son of Neriah is setting you against us, so that you will hand us over to the Chaldeans, to put us to death and have us deported to Babylon.
verses.display_text: Rather, Baruch son of Neriah is setting you against us, so that you will hand us over to the Chaldeans, to put us to death and have us deported to Babylon.

verses.text: Johanan, all the commanders of the force, and all the people did not obey the Lord’s voice by remaining in Judah’s land.
verses.display_text: Johanan, all the commanders of the force, and all the people did not obey the Lord’s voice by remaining in Judah’s land.

verses.text: Johanan and all the commanders of the force took all Judah’s survivors who had returned to live in the land:
verses.display_text: Johanan and all the commanders of the force took all Judah’s survivors who had returned to live in the land:

verses.text: the mighty men, the women, the little children, the king’s daughters, the people Nebuzaradan had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, and Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah.
verses.display_text: the mighty men, the women, the little children, the king’s daughters, the people Nebuzaradan had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, and Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah.

verses.text: They entered Egypt, for they had not obeyed the Lord’s voice. They entered Taphnas.
verses.display_text: They entered Egypt, for they had not obeyed the Lord’s voice. They entered Taphnas.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah at Taphnas:
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah at Taphnas:

verses.text: Take large stones for yourself and hide them in the forecourt at the gate of Pharaoh’s house at Taphnas, before the eyes of Judah’s men.
verses.display_text: Take large stones for yourself and hide them in the forecourt at the gate of Pharaoh’s house at Taphnas, before the eyes of Judah’s men.

verses.text: Say, Thus said the Lord: I am sending and will bring Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will place his throne above these stones that you hid and raise his weapons over them.
verses.display_text: Say, Thus said the Lord: I am sending and will bring Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will place his throne above these stones that you hid and raise his weapons over them.

verses.text: He will enter and strike Egypt’s land: those for death, to death; those for deportation, to deportation; and those for the sword, to the sword.
verses.display_text: He will enter and strike Egypt’s land: those for death, to death; those for deportation, to deportation; and those for the sword, to the sword.

verses.text: He will kindle fire in the houses of their gods, burn the houses, and deport the gods. He will delouse Egypt’s land as a shepherd delouses his garment, and he will go out in peace.
verses.display_text: He will kindle fire in the houses of their gods, burn the houses, and deport the gods. He will delouse Egypt’s land as a shepherd delouses his garment, and he will go out in peace.

verses.text: He will shatter the pillars of the City of the Sun, those in On, and burn their houses with fire.
verses.display_text: He will shatter the pillars of the City of the Sun, those in On, and burn their houses with fire.

verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah for all the Judeans living in Egypt’s land and those staying at Migdol, Taphnas, and in Pathoures’s land:
verses.display_text: The word that came to Jeremiah for all the Judeans living in Egypt’s land and those staying at Migdol, Taphnas, and in Pathoures’s land:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: You have seen all the calamities I brought upon Jerusalem and Judah’s cities. Behold, they are deserted of inhabitants,
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: You have seen all the calamities I brought upon Jerusalem and Judah’s cities. Behold, they are deserted of inhabitants,

verses.text: because of the wickedness they committed to embitter Me, going to burn incense to other gods whom you did not know.
verses.display_text: because of the wickedness they committed to embitter Me, going to burn incense to other gods whom you did not know.

verses.text: I sent you My servants the prophets at dawn, and I sent them saying, Do not commit this act of defilement that I hate.
verses.display_text: I sent you My servants the prophets at dawn, and I sent them saying, Do not commit this act of defilement that I hate.

verses.text: But they did not listen to Me or incline their ear to turn from their evils and stop burning incense to other gods.
verses.display_text: But they did not listen to Me or incline their ear to turn from their evils and stop burning incense to other gods.

verses.text: My anger and wrath dripped out and blazed in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem, and they became a desolation and an untrodden place, as on this day.
verses.display_text: My anger and wrath dripped out and blazed in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem, and they became a desolation and an untrodden place, as on this day.

verses.text: Now thus said the Lord Almighty: Why are you doing great evils against yourselves, cutting off from yourselves man and woman, little child and nursing infant from Judah, so that none of you remains,
verses.display_text: Now thus said the Lord Almighty: Why are you doing great evils against yourselves, cutting off from yourselves man and woman, little child and nursing infant from Judah, so that none of you remains,

verses.text: embittering Me with the work of your hands by burning incense to other gods in Egypt’s land, which you entered to live there, so that you are cut off and become a curse and a reproach among all the earth’s nations?
verses.display_text: embittering Me with the work of your hands by burning incense to other gods in Egypt’s land, which you entered to live there, so that you are cut off and become a curse and a reproach among all the earth’s nations?

verses.text: Have you forgotten your fathers’ evils, the evils of Judah’s kings, your rulers’ evils, and your wives’ evils, which they committed in Judah’s land and outside Jerusalem?
verses.display_text: Have you forgotten your fathers’ evils, the evils of Judah’s kings, your rulers’ evils, and your wives’ evils, which they committed in Judah’s land and outside Jerusalem?

verses.text: They have not stopped to this day and have not held fast to My ordinances, which I set before their fathers.
verses.display_text: They have not stopped to this day and have not held fast to My ordinances, which I set before their fathers.

verses.text: Therefore thus said the Lord: I am setting My face
verses.display_text: Therefore thus said the Lord: I am setting My face

verses.text: to destroy all the survivors in Egypt, and they will fall. By sword and famine they will perish, from the least to the greatest, and become a reproach, a destruction, and a curse.
verses.display_text: to destroy all the survivors in Egypt, and they will fall. By sword and famine they will perish, from the least to the greatest, and become a reproach, a destruction, and a curse.

verses.text: I will visit those staying in Egypt’s land as I visited Jerusalem, by sword, famine, and death.
verses.display_text: I will visit those staying in Egypt’s land as I visited Jerusalem, by sword, famine, and death.

verses.text: None of Judah’s remainder residing in Egypt’s land will be saved to return to Judah’s land, where they hope in their souls to return. They certainly will not return except those rescued.
verses.display_text: None of Judah’s remainder residing in Egypt’s land will be saved to return to Judah’s land, where they hope in their souls to return. They certainly will not return except those rescued.

verses.text: All the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, all the women, a great assembly, and all the people staying in Egypt’s land at Pathoures answered Jeremiah:
verses.display_text: All the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, all the women, a great assembly, and all the people staying in Egypt’s land at Pathoures answered Jeremiah:

verses.text: As for the word you spoke to us in the Lord’s name, we will not listen to you.
verses.display_text: As for the word you spoke to us in the Lord’s name, we will not listen to you.

verses.text: We will certainly do everything that will come from our mouths: burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her, as we, our fathers, our kings, and our rulers did in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem. We were filled with bread, were well off, and saw no calamities.
verses.display_text: We will certainly do everything that will come from our mouths: burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her, as we, our fathers, our kings, and our rulers did in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem. We were filled with bread, were well off, and saw no calamities.

verses.text: But when we stopped burning incense to the queen of heaven, we were all diminished and perished by sword and famine.
verses.display_text: But when we stopped burning incense to the queen of heaven, we were all diminished and perished by sword and famine.

verses.text: And when we burn incense to the queen of heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make cakes for her and pour out drink offerings to her without our husbands?
verses.display_text: And when we burn incense to the queen of heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make cakes for her and pour out drink offerings to her without our husbands?

verses.text: Jeremiah said to all the people—to the mighty men, the women, and all the people who had answered him:
verses.display_text: Jeremiah said to all the people—to the mighty men, the women, and all the people who had answered him:

verses.text: Was it not the incense you burned in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem—you, your fathers, your kings, your rulers, and the people of the land—that the Lord remembered, and did it not come into His heart?
verses.display_text: Was it not the incense you burned in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem—you, your fathers, your kings, your rulers, and the people of the land—that the Lord remembered, and did it not come into His heart?

verses.text: The Lord could no longer bear the wickedness of your actions and the abominations you had committed. Your land became a desolation, an untrodden place, and a curse, as on this day,
verses.display_text: The Lord could no longer bear the wickedness of your actions and the abominations you had committed. Your land became a desolation, an untrodden place, and a curse, as on this day,

verses.text: because you burned incense, sinned against the Lord, did not obey the Lord’s voice, and did not walk in His ordinances, law, and testimonies. These calamities have seized you.
verses.display_text: because you burned incense, sinned against the Lord, did not obey the Lord’s voice, and did not walk in His ordinances, law, and testimonies. These calamities have seized you.

verses.text: Jeremiah said to the people and the women, Hear the Lord’s word:
verses.display_text: Jeremiah said to the people and the women, Hear the Lord’s word:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: You women spoke with your mouths and fulfilled it with your hands, saying, We will certainly carry out our pledges that we pledged, to burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her. You firmly persisted in your pledges and indeed carried them out.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: You women spoke with your mouths and fulfilled it with your hands, saying, We will certainly carry out our pledges that we pledged, to burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her. You firmly persisted in your pledges and indeed carried them out.

verses.text: Therefore hear the Lord’s word, all Judah staying in Egypt’s land: I have sworn by My great name, said the Lord, that My name will no longer be in any Judean’s mouth to say, As the Lord, the Lord, lives, throughout Egypt’s land.
verses.display_text: Therefore hear the Lord’s word, all Judah staying in Egypt’s land: I have sworn by My great name, said the Lord, that My name will no longer be in any Judean’s mouth to say, As the Lord, the Lord, lives, throughout Egypt’s land.

verses.text: For I am watching over them to harm them, not do them good. All Judah living in Egypt’s land will perish by sword and famine until they perish.
verses.display_text: For I am watching over them to harm them, not do them good. All Judah living in Egypt’s land will perish by sword and famine until they perish.

verses.text: Those saved from the sword will return to Judah’s land, few in number. Judah’s survivors who settled in Egypt’s land to live there will know whose word will endure.
verses.display_text: Those saved from the sword will return to Judah’s land, few in number. Judah’s survivors who settled in Egypt’s land to live there will know whose word will endure.

verses.text: This will be the sign for you that I will visit you for evils:
verses.display_text: This will be the sign for you that I will visit you for evils:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: I am handing Ouaphre king of Egypt over to his enemy and those seeking his life, as I handed Zedekiah king of Judah over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his enemy who sought his life.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: I am handing Ouaphre king of Egypt over to his enemy and those seeking his life, as I handed Zedekiah king of Judah over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his enemy who sought his life.

verses.text: The word Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch son of Neriah when he wrote these words in the scroll from Jeremiah’s mouth, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:
verses.display_text: The word Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch son of Neriah when he wrote these words in the scroll from Jeremiah’s mouth, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord concerning you, Baruch:
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord concerning you, Baruch:

verses.text: For you said, Woe to me, woe to me! The Lord has added toil to my pain. I lay down amid groanings and found no rest.
verses.display_text: For you said, Woe to me, woe to me! The Lord has added toil to my pain. I lay down amid groanings and found no rest.

verses.text: Tell him, Thus said the Lord: Those I have built up I am tearing down, and those I have planted I am plucking up.
verses.display_text: Tell him, Thus said the Lord: Those I have built up I am tearing down, and those I have planted I am plucking up.

verses.text: Are you seeking great things for yourself? Do not seek them, for I am bringing calamities upon all flesh, says the Lord. I will give your life as gain wherever you walk.
verses.display_text: Are you seeking great things for yourself? Do not seek them, for I am bringing calamities upon all flesh, says the Lord. I will give your life as gain wherever you walk.

verses.text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Amitaal daughter of Jeremiah, from Lobena.
verses.display_text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Amitaal daughter of Jeremiah, from Lobena.

verses.text: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his force came against Jerusalem. They enclosed her with a palisade and built around her with squared stones.
verses.display_text: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his force came against Jerusalem. They enclosed her with a palisade and built around her with squared stones.

verses.text: The city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
verses.display_text: The city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

verses.text: On the ninth of the month, the famine grew severe in the city, and there were no loaves for the people of the land.
verses.display_text: On the ninth of the month, the famine grew severe in the city, and there were no loaves for the people of the land.

verses.text: The city was breached, and all the warriors went out at night by the gate between the wall and the outer wall beside the king’s garden, while the Chaldeans surrounded the city. They went by the road to Arabah,
verses.display_text: The city was breached, and all the warriors went out at night by the gate between the wall and the outer wall beside the king’s garden, while the Chaldeans surrounded the city. They went by the road to Arabah,

verses.text: and the Chaldean force pursued the king and overtook him beyond Jericho. All his servants scattered away from him.
verses.display_text: and the Chaldean force pursued the king and overtook him beyond Jericho. All his servants scattered away from him.

verses.text: They captured the king and brought him to the king of Babylon at Deblatha, and he spoke to him in judgment.
verses.display_text: They captured the king and brought him to the king of Babylon at Deblatha, and he spoke to him in judgment.

verses.text: The king of Babylon slaughtered Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, and he slaughtered all Judah’s rulers at Deblatha.
verses.display_text: The king of Babylon slaughtered Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, and he slaughtered all Judah’s rulers at Deblatha.

verses.text: He blinded Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in fetters. The king of Babylon brought him to Babylon and put him in a mill house until the day he died.
verses.display_text: He blinded Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in fetters. The king of Babylon brought him to Babylon and put him in a mill house until the day he died.

verses.text: In the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuzaradan, the chief guard who stood before the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: In the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuzaradan, the chief guard who stood before the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

verses.text: He burned the Lord’s house, the king’s house, and all the city’s houses; every great house he burned with fire.
verses.display_text: He burned the Lord’s house, the king’s house, and all the city’s houses; every great house he burned with fire.

verses.text: The Chaldean force with the chief guard pulled down the whole wall of Jerusalem all around.
verses.display_text: The Chaldean force with the chief guard pulled down the whole wall of Jerusalem all around.

verses.text: The chief guard left the remaining people as vinedressers and farmers.
verses.display_text: The chief guard left the remaining people as vinedressers and farmers.

verses.text: The Chaldeans shattered the bronze pillars in the Lord’s house, the bases, and the bronze Sea in the Lord’s house. They took their bronze and carried it to Babylon.
verses.display_text: The Chaldeans shattered the bronze pillars in the Lord’s house, the bases, and the bronze Sea in the Lord’s house. They took their bronze and carried it to Babylon.

verses.text: And the rim, the bowls, the meat forks, and all the bronze utensils with which they performed service,
verses.display_text: And the rim, the bowls, the meat forks, and all the bronze utensils with which they performed service,

verses.text: and the saphphoth, the masmaroth, the pouring vessels, the lampstands, the incense bowls, and the ladles—those of gold, gold, and those of silver, silver—the chief guard took.
verses.display_text: and the saphphoth, the masmaroth, the pouring vessels, the lampstands, the incense bowls, and the ladles—those of gold, gold, and those of silver, silver—the chief guard took.

verses.text: The two pillars, the one Sea, and the twelve bronze calves beneath the Sea, which King Solomon made for the Lord’s house—their bronze was beyond weighing.
verses.display_text: The two pillars, the one Sea, and the twelve bronze calves beneath the Sea, which King Solomon made for the Lord’s house—their bronze was beyond weighing.

verses.text: As for the pillars, one pillar was thirty-five cubits high, and a cord of twelve cubits encircled it. Its thickness was four fingerbreadths all around,
verses.display_text: As for the pillars, one pillar was thirty-five cubits high, and a cord of twelve cubits encircled it. Its thickness was four fingerbreadths all around,

verses.text: and a bronze cornice was on them. The projection of one cornice was five cubits in length, and a net and pomegranates surrounded the cornice, all of bronze. The second pillar had the same: eight pomegranates per cubit over the twelve cubits.

verses.text: There were ninety-six pomegranates on one side; all the pomegranates around the net numbered one hundred.

verses.text: The chief guard took the first priest, the second priest, and the three men guarding the road,
verses.display_text: The chief guard took the first priest, the second priest, and the three men guarding the road,

verses.text: and one eunuch who supervised the warriors, seven prominent men in the king’s presence who were found in the city, the scribe of the forces who kept records for the people of the land, and sixty people from the people of the land found inside the city.

verses.text: Nebuzaradan, the chief guard, took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Deblatha,
verses.display_text: Nebuzaradan, the chief guard, took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Deblatha,

verses.text: and the king of Babylon struck them at Deblatha in Aimath’s land.
verses.display_text: and the king of Babylon struck them at Deblatha in Aimath’s land.

verses.text: In the thirty-seventh year after Ioakim king of Judah had been deported, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fourth of the month, Oulaimaradach king of Babylon, in the year he became king, took up the head of Ioakim king of Judah and brought him out of the house where he was guarded.
verses.display_text: In the thirty-seventh year after Ioakim king of Judah had been deported, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fourth of the month, Oulaimaradach king of Babylon, in the year he became king, took up the head of Ioakim king of Judah and brought him out of the house where he was guarded.

verses.text: He spoke kindly to him and placed his throne above the thrones of the kings with him in Babylon.
verses.display_text: He spoke kindly to him and placed his throne above the thrones of the kings with him in Babylon.

verses.text: He changed his prison robe, and he ate bread continually before him all the days he lived.

verses.text: His allowance was given to him continually by the king of Babylon, from day to day until the day he died.
